boundary: Expected dispositions are preregistered hypotheses, not observed x2 outcomes.
bounded_practice: postal-depot registered-item intake, mis-sort quarantine, damaged-item hold, address privacy, accessible notice, workload, and shift handover as a learning and synthetic-design lens only

proposals.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every invalid delay, cap, idempotency, transition, quarantine, and duplicate-credit mutation is rejected while no external request is sent.
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded retry tribunal can parse declared Retry-After forms, cap backoff, make synthetic jitter reproducible, require an idempotency precondition, expose circuit state, quarantine terminal failures, and prevent repeated attempts from receiving duplicate evidence credit.
proposals.null_or_failure_condition: The tribunal accepts an invalid or negative delay, unbounded backoff, hidden nondeterminism, a retry without an idempotency precondition, an illegal circuit transition, a dropped dead-letter record, or duplicate evidence credit.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Disable automatic retry, preserve the failed attempt and payload digest, and require explicit owner review.
proposals.title: Method Flow Retry-After parsing, exponential-backoff cap, deterministic-jitter seed, idempotency precondition, circuit-breaker state, dead-letter quarantine, and evidence-credit tribunal

proposals.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every accepted row names its algebra, region, state/vector, spectrum, analyticity, domain, locality, gauge, EFT, unit, and non-observation obligations; operational signalling and empirical promotion stay false.
proposals.hypothesis: A typed Reeh-Schlieder obligation board can distinguish cyclicity, separating properties, local algebra, spectrum and analyticity assumptions, domain and locality, and no-signalling limits from empirical GMUT evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure_condition: The board omits a cyclic or separating domain, local-algebra scope, spectrum or analyticity premise, locality, gauge and EFT scope, units, or converts formal state-density language into signalling, preparation power, physical prediction, or observed physics.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw the formal board, retain the missing premise as a negative, and make no state-preparation, force, likelihood, stability, or completeness claim.
proposals.title: GMUT Reeh-Schlieder cyclic-vector, separating-vector, local-algebra, spectrum, analyticity, domain, locality, no-signalling, gauge, EFT, unit, and observation-firewall obligation board
